newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens stock exchange clears Etane prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Athens stock exchange clears Etane prospectus.

text.p: The Athens bourse approved the prospectus for the initial public offering of construction firm Etane which will be listed on its small-cap parallel market.
Etane will issue 420,000 common registered shares with a par value of 100 drachmas. Of these, 20,000 will be privately placed. The issue price will be announced at a later date.
Etane ATE specialises in prefabricated construction, renovation and rehabilitation of landmark buildings and is a member of Europe's 500 -- an association of fast growing European companies.
Managing director Vagelis Zavliaris, a civil engineer, is also the vice-president of Europe's 500 - the Association for Dynamic Entrepreneurs.
Lead underwriter for the issue is Telesis Securities with Telesis Capital the issue advisor.
Etane had net profit of 402 million drachmas in 1996 on turnover of 2.29 billion. Projections for 1997 see net earnings growing 25 percent to 503 million drachmas.
The company will use IPO proceeds to finance its investment programme which includes equipment acquisitions and to pay down debt.
